rationale: The agent performed an order-modifying write without first confirming the change with the user, violating the confirm-before-write requirement. It did not provide the requested information about how much the user would get back in total. It also did not demonstrate that it identified the cheapest Desk Lamp (no search or comparison shown), and the use of a gift_card payment_method_id suggests charging a gift card rather than refunding the price difference to a new gift card as requested. Authentication is unclear beyond a name/zip lookup and user details fetch, with no explicit verification step. Therefore the request was not completed in line with policy and key user asks were not answered.
